name: Burp Suite Community Edition
what: An intercepting HTTP(S) proxy and manual web testing toolkit. Community Edition covers proxying, repeater-style request editing and basic tools; Burp Suite Professional adds the automated scanner, Intruder at full speed and collaboration features.
when: For hands-on testing of web apps and APIs you own or have written permission to test, especially when you need to manipulate requests that automated scanners miss.
cost_note: Community Edition is free for download and use under PortSwigger's Community terms. Professional is a paid per-user subscription.
example: Download Community Edition from PortSwigger and install the CA certificate in your browser for HTTPS interception.
Configure the browser proxy to Burp, browse only the in-scope application, and confirm traffic appears in the Proxy HTTP history.
Send interesting requests to Repeater, change parameters safely, and note authz/idor behaviour for the report.
If your team needs active scanning and unrestricted Intruder, evaluate Professional against your budget; do not confuse Community limits with product bugs.
pitfalls: Community throttles some automated features; that is expected, not a misconfiguration.
Intercepting credentials and session tokens means the Burp project file is sensitive; encrypt and delete after the engagement.
Active scanning (Pro) can submit destructive requests; keep it off production unless the rules of engagement say otherwise.
